validation.accepted: Single-subsystem decoder change: complete identity, passive video, DOS regmap debugfs/K9, HEVC/JPEG smoke and firmware PD B state
limitations: Single-subsystem gates only; nine-class regression, 600-second motion, HID injection, EDID, audio, media and GPU were not run.
Decode smoke covers three HEVC conformance streams and three JPEG fixtures; full HEVC/H264/MPEG2 suites were not rerun on this formal package.
Historical .44 acceptance was HEVC 129/132 and JPEG 3/3; three HEVC streams remain rejected, not full decoder parity.
One successful natural default boot does not establish a cold-reset fix.
Formal build.sh was used; W=1, sparse and KUnit were not rerun in this deployment task.
The supplementary cross-boot journal cursor was invalid; continuous UART, startup journal and decode incremental kernel log were checked instead.
